C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS.Summary: Make three toolkit checks able to observe the thing they are named for: ship the packed modules CI never sees (A48.5), feed the scope audit a real diff (corr 138), and resolve archived plans with an explicit absence when the audit is skipped (corr 139).
C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS.Problem:
Three surfaces share one shape — a green result produced by a check that was never in a position to be red (D16; A51.4):
1. A48.5 / ship path. package.json#files omits src/gates and src/review. The packed CLI fails at import on every invocation that needs those modules. validate:packed is red at HEAD when run, but validate:ci does not include it, so every phase since Phase 5 reported green CI while the published package was broken. prepublishOnly → validate:release → validate:packed blocks publishing correctly; CI does not.
2. Correction 138 / scope audit input. auditScopeOutsideWriteScope is fed only by listRepositoryChangedFiles (grace-cursor.ts), which runs git status --porcelain. Committed work is invisible. §0.5 requires the executor to commit before reporting, so at close time available:true with changedFiles:0 is the normal case. ngrace review exposes --path, --change, and --format only; options.changedFiles exists in runReview but has no CLI binding. Phases 6–8 each closed citing review → 0 findings as the mechanized half of A33.3; for the scope audit that claim has been vacuous every time. On the Phase 8 branch against origin/main, C-SELECTION's ObservedWriteScope missed scripts/release-check.ts and src/artifact/scale-ergonomics.test.ts — legitimate writes, unreported because the audit had no input.
3. Correction 139 / archived subject. runReview resolves the plan only under changesActiveDir. For any archived bundle scopeFiles stays empty, the audit guard is false, and the summary still prints "No review findings" with no absence value. Every archived bundle on this track is permanently un-auditable for scope under --change, and a skipped audit reads like a passed audit.
Phase 8's board row stays COMPLETE. None of these is a defect in Phase 8's selection surface; they are Phase 5/6 surfaces that Phase 8's close cited as evidence.

Goals.Goal: package.json#files lists src/gates and src/review (and any other production modules the packed binary imports). validate:packed is green at HEAD after the allowlist fix.
validate:ci includes validate:packed, so a missing packed module fails the same gate every phase already runs — not only prepublishOnly.

ngrace review accepts a caller-supplied diff: --base <ref> and/or --changed-files (exact flags as designed at plan time). The CLI can supply one against a branch base so a post-commit close still feeds the scope audit.
When no changed-files source is available, the scope audit emits absence with a reason (scope audit not run — no changed files available), never a silent clean summary.
runReview resolves plan.xml under changesActiveDir or changesArchiveDir. An archived --change still supplies ObservedWriteScope to the audit.

When the plan cannot be resolved for a named --change, the scope audit emits absence with a reason (scope audit not run — no plan found for <id> under active/ or archive/), never a silent clean summary.

Constraints.Constraint: Spec only until planned and approved. This draft schedules the work; it does not authorize production code (Phase 8 round 3 / A51).
Do not reopen Phase 8 or edit archived C-SELECTION. The OWS omission is recorded in A50's append-only correction (A51); the archive stays immutable.
F1 / invariant 8: ngrace review remains read-only. Diff input is evaluation input, not a write path. Recording verdicts stays on ngrace gate verdict.
D14: review.* codes stay on the review surface; lint never emits them. No new gate.* from lint.
Absence with a reason (D5, rule 7) for every skipped audit path. A skipped audit that prints like a passed audit is the failure this change exists to prevent (A43.1 / A51.2).
Surgical diffs. No new runtime dependencies. Skill mirrors stay byte-identical if skill text changes (§12.2).
Standing rule 11: every emitted "No review findings" / absence string must read true aloud given the inputs the run actually had.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Re-running or re-closing Phases 6–8. Correct the close records already amended; do not re-litigate their board rows.
Making the apply gate distinguish self-review from detached review (A33.3 / D11 still require existence of a recorded verdict, not toolkit-verified trustworthiness of residual judgment).
Paying A36.4 / A46.6 graph-module debt for gates and review modules. Out of this change's scope unless required to keep lint green after files list changes.
Full mutate / differential revert-and-rerun as a required audit (Phase 6 Q1 stands).
Changing selection (Phase 8) or failure localization (Phase 7) behavior.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PACKED-MODULES-SHIP: A48.5. package.json#files includes src/gates and src/review. Discriminating negatives: validate:packed is green; removing either directory from files makes validate:packed red; release-check / dual-allowlist stays consistent with files (same honesty bar as grace-context in Phase 8).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PACKED-IN-CI: A48.5. validate:ci runs validate:packed. Discriminating negative: a deliberate omission of a packed production import fails validate:ci, not only validate:release / prepublishOnly.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SCOPE-DIFF-INPUT: Corr 138. ngrace review accepts a diff input (--base and/or --changed-files as planned). Against a branch with committed files outside a named change's ObservedWriteScope, the scope audit reports those paths. Discriminating negatives: post-commit clean porcelain alone is not treated as "scope clean" when a base ref shows out-of-scope paths; help text names the flags.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SCOPE-ABSENCE-NO-INPUT: Corr 138. When no changed-files source is available, review emits an explicit absence for the scope audit (reason: no changed files available), and the summary does not read as a full pass of that audit. Discriminating negative: "No review findings" is false when the audit was skipped for lack of input.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ARCHIVE-PLAN-RESOLVE: Corr 139. --change on an archived bundle resolves plan.xml under archive/ and runs the scope audit when a diff input is also present. Discriminating negative: archived C-SELECTION (or a fixture archive) is not permanently un-auditable solely because it left active/.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SCOPE-ABSENCE-NO-PLAN: Corr 139. When --change names an id with no plan under active/ or archive/, review emits absence (reason: no plan found for <id>), never a silent clean scope result.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: validate:packed green and listed in validate:ci; unit tests for --base/--changed-files scope findings and for archive plan resolution; absence strings for no-input and no-plan paths; ngrace review --change on an archived fixture with a supplied base shows out-of-scope paths when present; root lint 0 errors.
